items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I say, Charles, I think I'd better get off at Broadway because I got to go and get my music

ctx.x: Says, go on, get on, get on, get on. I say, Charles, I think I'd better get off at Broadway because I got to go and get my music, you don't mind, do you?
No, no, but now, you come back because I'm having a party for my birthday.
